title.en: The gradient: how strong, which way

t.zh: <wiki-ref to="edge-as-rapid-change"></wiki-ref>：gx 和 gy 合起来是一个箭头，叫梯度，指向亮度增加最快的方向；它的长度说明边有多强，不管边朝哪边。
t.en: An <wiki-ref to="edge-as-rapid-change"></wiki-ref>: gx and gy together make an arrow, the gradient, pointing the way brightness rises fastest; its length says how strong the edge is, whichever way it runs.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：怎样不管方向、只量出边有多强？比如 gx = 4、gy = 0 时它指向右，gx = 0、gy = −4 时指向上（y 向下数）。用 Sobel 接出梯度的大小；新元件开平方。
t.en: This level asks: how is an edge's strength measured, whatever its direction? With gx = 4 and gy = 0 it points right, with gx = 0 and gy = −4 up (y counts down). Wire the gradient's size from the Sobel filter; new part: square root.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref>：方向由 gx、gy 定，大小是 √(gx² + gy²)。这台边缘检测器后面还会用到。
after.en: This is the <wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref>: its direction set by gx and gy, its size √(gx² + gy²). This edge detector is used again later.

t.zh: 新元件<part-ref to="part:sqrt"></part-ref>给出平方根。
t.en: New part: <part-ref to="part:sqrt"></part-ref> gives the square root.

brief.zh: 输入一张图：交出每个位置的梯度大小 √(gx² + gy²)。
brief.en: Given an image, give the gradient's size √(gx² + gy²) at each position.

hint.zh: gx、gy 有正有负；直接相加，正负会抵消。
hint.en: gx and gy can be negative; added as they are, they cancel.
